# Dan's Drains

> Licensed, insured plumber based in Armonk, NY, serving homeowners and small
> businesses across Westchester County. Over 15 years of experience with
> everyday repairs, emergency plumbing, water heaters, drain cleaning, leak
> repairs, sewer and septic-connected plumbing, sump pumps, fixture
> installations, and light commercial work. Same-day service available, upfront
> pricing, clean and respectful technicians.
